title: 第13章 你也死第14章 返利帝阶天魔影
slug: 杂役都是仙帝你管这叫没落宗门
lines: 67号贵宾席中，林玄直接斩出一剑，剑指冥空王！
纯白剑光，宛如一道流星，将阴暗的拍卖场彻底照亮，如同白昼！
这一剑，吸引了在场所有人的目光。
谁也没想到，居然有人敢对冥空王出剑。
“好胆！”
同样，这一剑也出乎了冥空王的预料，他还真没想到这拍卖行之内，还有人敢忤逆他！
简直是……找死！
目光直接锁定了位于67号贵宾席中的青年，正欲无视掉那斩来的剑光，直接将那青年捏死，但很快冥空王便是察觉到了一丝不对劲……
那道剑光……
随着剑光距离冥空王越来越近，那剑光之中蕴含着的恐怖剑意，终于是被冥空王所感知到。
一瞬间，只觉得一股死亡之意袭遍全身，仿佛是被某种大恐怖盯上一般！
“不好！”
冥空王根本来不及去思考太多，遁术瞬间施展，便是以极快的速度爆退……
但他快，剑光，更快！
在无数人震撼的目光下，冥空王的右臂，硬生生的被剑光斩断！鲜血喷涌而出！让得其脚下红毯，更鲜艳了几分。
这一幕，来得太快，发生的太过突然……
捂着断臂，冥空王惊恐的看着林玄，眼神中除了恐惧以外，还有浓浓的疑惑。
这青年，是谁！？
好恐怖的一剑，别人或许不知道，只有冥空王自己知道，刚才那一剑，如果不是自己及时施展从焚天秘境得来的那门高阶遁术，此时的自己，恐怕就不仅只是断掉一臂那么简单了。
而是……死！
在场之人，包括拍卖行之主月王在内，均是被林玄的这一剑，惊的说不出话来。
特别是月王。
她是认识林玄的，那位将紫蝎妖王尸骨带来，委托自己拍卖的青年。
她依稀记得，当时她还询问过对方，这紫蝎妖王的尸骨从何而来。
当时对方说的是，他斩的。
这话，暮月只当是对方不愿说出真相，随意找的借口罢了，并未当真。
但现在……
暮月苦笑。
content_en:
“Buzz——!”
In the VIP table No. 67, Lin Xuan directly slashed out a sword, pointing at King Mingkong!
The pure white sword light was like a shooting star, completely illuminating the dark auction house like daylight!
This sword attracted the attention of everyone present.
No one expected that someone would dare to use a sword against King Mingkong.
"How brave!"
Similarly, this sword was beyond King Mingkong's expectation. He really didn't expect that there would be anyone in the auction house who dared to disobey him!
It’s simply...looking for death!
His eyes were directly locked on the young man sitting in the VIP seat No. 67. He was about to ignore the sword light and squeeze the young man to death, but soon King Mingkong noticed something was wrong...
That sword light...
As the sword light got closer and closer to King Mingkong, the terrifying sword intent contained in the sword light was finally sensed by King Mingkong.
For a moment, I felt a sense of death rushing through my body, as if I was being targeted by some great terror!
"Not good!"
King Mingkong didn't have time to think too much. He used his escape technique instantly and retreated at an extremely fast speed...
But he is fast, Jian Guang, faster!
"Tsk-!"
Under the shocked eyes of countless people, King Mingkong's right arm was cut off by the light of the sword! Blood spurts out! It made the red carpet under her feet even more vivid.
This scene came too fast and happened too suddenly...
"You..."
Holding his broken arm, King Mingkong looked at Lin Xuan in horror. In addition to fear, there was also deep doubt in his eyes.
Who is this young man! ?
What a terrifying sword. Others may not know about it, but King Mingkong himself knows that if he hadn’t used the high-level escape technique from the Burning Sky Secret Realm in time with that sword strike just now, he might have suffered more than just a broken arm.
But...die!
Everyone present, including the owner of the auction house, Moon King, was shocked and speechless by Lin Xuan's sword.
Especially the Moon King.
She knew Lin Xuan, the young man who brought the body of the Purple Scorpion Demon King and entrusted her to auction it.
She vaguely remembered that she asked the other party at that time where the bones of the Purple Scorpion Demon King came from.
What the other party said at that time was that he had killed it.
Mu Yue regarded these words as a random excuse made by the other party because he did not want to tell the truth, and did not take them seriously.
But now...
Muyue smiled bitterly.
